translations.text: Blessed is the person who has not followed the counsel of the ungodly, stood on the path of sinners, or sat in the seat of corrupt people.
Instead, his delight is in the law of the Lord, and he will meditate on his law day and night.
He will be like a tree planted beside streams of water, which will yield its fruit in its season. Its leaves will not wither, and everything he does will prosper.
The ungodly are not like this—not like this! Instead, they will be like chaff that the wind blows away from the face of the earth.
Therefore, the ungodly will not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the assembly of the righteous.
For the Lord knows the path of the righteous, but the path of the ungodly will perish.
Why have the nations become arrogant, and the peoples plotted empty things?
The kings of the earth took their stand, and the rulers gathered together against the Lord and his anointed one. Musical interlude.
Let us tear apart their bonds and throw their yoke off us.
The one who dwells in the heavens will laugh at them, and the Lord will mock them.
Then he will speak to them in his anger and terrify them in his fury.
But I have been appointed king by him over Zion, his holy mountain.
I proclaim the Lord’s decree. The Lord said to me, “You are my son; today I have fathered you.
Ask me, and I will give you nations as your inheritance, and your possession will extend to the ends of the earth.
You will shepherd them with an iron rod and shatter them like a potter’s vessels.”
Now, therefore, kings, pay attention! Receive instruction, all you who judge the earth.
Serve the Lord with fear, and rejoice before him with trembling.
Embrace instruction, lest the Lord become angry and you perish on the path of his truth, when his fury suddenly blazes up. Blessed are all who put their trust in him.
A psalm of David, when he fled from his son Absalom.
Lord, why have those who oppress me become so many? Many have risen up against me.
Many say of my soul, “He has no salvation from his God.” Musical pause.
But you, Lord, are my protector, my glory, and the one who lifts up my head.
With my voice I cried out to the Lord, and he heard me from his holy mountain. Musical pause.
I lay down and slept; I awoke, because the Lord will uphold me.
I will not fear tens of thousands of people who oppose me all around.
Rise up, Lord! Save me, my God! For you have struck all who are my enemies without cause; you have shattered the teeth of sinners.
Salvation belongs to the Lord, and your favor rests on your people.
For the end. A psalm of David.
When I cried out to you, you heard me, God of my righteousness. In my distress you gave me room. Have mercy on me, and hear my prayer, God. Musical pause.
Children of humanity, how long will your hearts remain hardened? Why do you love what is empty and seek lies?
Know that the Lord has honored his holy one. The Lord heard me when I cried out to him.
Be angry, but do not sin. Feel remorse on your beds for what you say in your hearts.
Offer a sacrifice of righteousness, and put your hope in the Lord. Musical pause.
Many say, “Who will show us good things?” The light of your face has appeared over us, Lord.
You have put joy in my heart. They have prospered through their harvest of grain, wine, and oil.
But I will lie down in peace and fall asleep at once, because you alone, Lord, have made me dwell in hope.
For the end. Concerning her who will inherit. A psalm of David.
Listen to my words, Lord; understand my cry.
Pay attention to the sound of my plea, my King and my God, because I will cry out to you, Lord, in the morning.
You will hear my voice in the morning. I will appear before you and watch.
For you are not a God who desires lawlessness, and an evil person will not stay beside you.
Nor will lawless people stand before your eyes. You have hated everyone who practices lawlessness.
You will destroy everyone who tells lies. The Lord detests a bloodthirsty and deceitful person.
But through your abundant mercy I will enter your holy place. I will bow down toward your holy temple in fear of you.
Lead me, Lord, in your righteousness because of my enemies. Make your path straight before me.
For there is no truth in their mouths. Their tongue and their heart are empty. Their throat is an open grave. Snake venom is under their lips. They have practiced deceit with their tongues.
Judge them, God. Let them fall through their own plans. Drive them out because of their many acts of wickedness, for they have provoked you to anger, Lord.
Let everyone who trusts in you rejoice. They will be glad forever and dwell in hope. Let everyone who loves your name boast in you.
For you will bless the righteous person, Lord. Like a shield, you have made your favor a crown over us.
For the end. With praises. Concerning the eighth. A psalm of David.
Lord, do not rebuke me in your anger or discipline me in your wrath.
Have mercy on me, Lord, for I am weak. Heal me, Lord, for my bones are troubled.
And my soul is deeply troubled. But you, Lord—how long will this last?
Return, Lord; rescue my soul. Save me, Lord, because of your mercy.
For no one among the dead remembers you. Who will praise you in the underworld?
I am worn out from my groaning. Every night I will drench my bed; I will soak my couch with my tears.
My eye is troubled from weeping. I have grown old among all my enemies.
Get away from me, all you who practice lawlessness, for the Lord has heard the sound of my weeping.
The Lord has heard my plea; the Lord has accepted my prayer.
All my enemies will be ashamed and deeply troubled. Let them turn back and be utterly ashamed in an instant.
A psalm of David, which he spoke to the Lord concerning the words of Cush, son of Jemini.
Lord my God, I have trusted in you. Save me from everyone pursuing me, and rescue me.
Otherwise he may tear my soul apart like a lion, with no one to save and no one to rescue.
Lord my God, if I have done this, if there is injustice in my hands,
if I have repaid with evil those who repay me, then may I fall helpless before my enemies.
Let the enemy pursue my soul and catch it. Let him trample my life into the ground and make my glory lie in the dust. Pause.
Rise, Lord, in your anger. Lift yourself up at the boundaries of my enemies. Rise according to the command you have given.
An assembly of peoples will surround you, and for its sake return on high.
The Lord will judge the peoples. Judge me, Lord, according to my righteousness and according to the innocence within me.
Let the wickedness of sinners come to an end, and you will set the righteous person upright. God is the one who examines hearts and kidneys.
My help is truly with God, who saves those whose hearts are upright.
God is a just judge, strong and patient; he will not bring his anger every day.
If you do not turn back, he will sharpen his sword. He has drawn his bow and made it ready.
In it he has prepared instruments of death. He has made his arrows for those who are to be burned.
Look, injustice has gone into labor, conceived trouble, and given birth to lawlessness.
He dug a pit and hollowed it out. He will fall into the hole he made.
His trouble will return upon his own head, and his injustice will come down upon the crown of his head.
I will praise the Lord according to his righteousness, and I will sing to the name of the Lord Most High.
For the end, concerning the winepresses. A psalm of [?].
Lord, our Lord, how wonderful your name is throughout the whole earth! For your splendor has been raised above the heavens.
You have prepared praise from the mouths of little children and nursing infants because of your enemies, to put an end to the enemy and the avenger.
For I will look at the heavens, the works of your fingers, the moon and the stars that you yourself established.
What is a human being that you remember him, or a son of man that you care for him?
You made him a little lower than the angels; you crowned him with glory and honor.
You appointed him over all the works of your hands; you put everything under his feet:
All the sheep and cattle, and also the animals of the field,
And the birds of the sky and the fish of the sea, those that travel along the paths of the seas.
Lord, our Lord, how wonderful your name is throughout the whole earth!
For the end. Concerning the hidden things of the son. A psalm of David.
I will give thanks to you, Lord, with all my heart; I will tell of all your wonders.
I will be glad and rejoice in you; I will sing praises to your name, Most High.
When my enemy turns back, they will grow weak and fall before you.
For you have upheld my right and my cause; you sat on your throne, judging with righteousness.
You rebuked the nations; the ungodly person perished. You erased their name forever and ever.
The enemy's swords have failed completely. You demolished the cities; their memory has openly perished.
The Lord remains forever; he has prepared his throne for judgment.
He is the one who will judge the world with righteousness; he will judge the peoples with fairness.
The Lord has become a refuge for the poor, a helper in times of distress.
Let everyone who knows your name put their hope in you, for you have not abandoned those who seek you, Lord.
Sing praises to the Lord who dwells in Zion; tell of his deeds among the nations.
For, in making inquiry, he remembered their blood, and he did not forget the cry of the poor.
Have mercy on me, Lord. Look at the humiliation I suffer from my enemies, you who lift me up from the gates of death,
So that I may declare all your praises at the gates of the daughter of Zion. I will rejoice in your salvation.
The nations have become trapped in the destruction they brought about; let their feet be caught in the trap they hid.
The Lord has revealed himself by carrying out judgments; let the sinner be caught in the works of his own hands. Song. Interlude.
Let sinners return to the underworld, all the nations that forget God.
For the poor will not be forgotten forever; the endurance of the needy will not perish forever.
Rise up, Lord! Do not let humankind prevail. Let the nations be judged before you.
Appoint a lawgiver over them, Lord. Let all the nations know that they are human. Pause.
Why, Lord, have you gone far away from us and been unmindful in times of trouble?
When the ungodly exalts himself, the poor burn. They will be caught in the schemes they devise.
For the sinner is praised for the desires of his soul, and the one who acts unjustly is blessed.
The sinner has provoked the Lord with the greatness of his anger. He will not seek God; God is not before him.
His ways are defiled at all times. He has removed your judgments from before him. He will rule over all his enemies.
For he has said in his heart, “I will not be shaken, from generation to generation, without suffering harm.”
His mouth is full of curses, bitterness, and deceit. Trouble and suffering are under his tongue.
He sits in places of ambush with the rich, and in hidden places to kill an innocent person. His eyes watch the poor.
He lies in ambush in a hidden place, like a lion in its den, to seize a poor person as he drags him away.
He will lower himself in his ambush; he will crouch and fall as he overpowers the poor.
For he has said in his heart, “God has forgotten. He has turned his face away so that he will never look.”
Rise up, Lord God! Let your hand be raised. Do not forget the poor.
Why has the ungodly provoked God? For he has said in his heart, “You will not investigate.”
You see, for you pay attention to suffering and anger, so that they may be placed in your hands. The poor person will entrust himself to you; you are the one who helps the orphan.
Break the arm of the sinner and the wicked person. They will search for his sin but will not find him because of it.
The Lord will reign forever and forevermore. You nations will be uprooted from his land.
The Lord has heard the desire of the poor. His ear has paid attention to the readiness of their hearts.
Judge the orphan and the oppressed, so that a human being may no longer boast on the earth.
For the end. A psalm of David. I have trusted in the Lord. How can you say to my soul, “Fly away to the mountains like a bird”?
For look, the sinners have drawn their bow. They have prepared their arrows in their quiver, to release arrows and shoot in secret at those whose hearts are upright.
For they have torn down what you established. But what has the righteous person done?
The Lord is in his holy temple. The Lord’s throne is in heaven. His eyes watch the inhabited world; his eyelids examine humankind.
The Lord will examine the righteous and the ungodly. But whoever loves injustice hates his own soul.
He will rain snares upon sinners. Fire, sulfur, and a stormy wind are the portion of their cup.
For the Lord is righteous, and he has loved righteousness. His face has looked upon the upright.
For the end, concerning the eighth. A psalm of David.
Save me, Lord, because the holy person has disappeared, because truthfulness has diminished among human beings.
Each person spoke empty words to his neighbor, with deceitful lips, with one heart, and he spoke with his heart.
The Lord will cut off every deceitful lip and every tongue that speaks boastful words.
They said, “We will exalt our tongue. Our lips are under our own control. Who is lord over us?”
Because of the suffering of the poor and the groaning of the needy, the Lord said, “Now I will rise. I will establish salvation and speak boldly through it.”
The words of the Lord are pure words, like silver that has been heated and refined, purified in the earth seven times.
But you, Lord, will guard us and save us from this generation forever.
The ungodly will walk about together. In keeping with your greatness, you have increased the number of human beings.
For the end. A psalm of David.
How long, Lord, will you forget me completely? How long will you turn your face away from me?
How long will I make plans in my soul, with sorrow in my heart by day? How long will my enemy exalt himself over me?
Turn and listen to me, Lord my God. Give light to my eyes, so that I do not sleep in death.
Let my enemy not say, “I have overcome him.” Those who oppress me will rejoice if I am shaken.
But I have put my hope in your mercy. My heart will rejoice in your salvation. I will sing to the Lord, who has done good to me, and I will sing praises to the name of the Lord Most High.
For the end. A psalm of David. The fool said in his heart, “There is no God.” They became corrupt and defiled themselves in their thoughts. There is no one who does good, not even one.
The Lord looked down from heaven upon human beings to see whether there was anyone wise who sought God.

They all turned aside; together they became useless. There is no one who does good, not even one. Their throat is an open grave. They practiced deceit with their tongues. Snake venom is under their lips. Their mouth is full of curses and bitterness. Their feet are quick to shed blood. Destruction and suffering are on their roads. They have not known the way of peace. The fear of God is not before their eyes.
Will not all those who practice lawlessness understand? They consume my people like a meal of bread. They have not called upon the Lord.
There they were filled with fear, where there was nothing to fear, because God is among the righteous generation.
You have shamed the poor person's plans, but the Lord is his hope.
Who will bring Israel's salvation out of Zion? When the Lord brings back his people from captivity, Jacob will rejoice and Israel will be glad.
A psalm of David. Lord, who will dwell in your dwelling place? Who will rest on your holy mountain?
It is the person who walks in holiness, practices righteousness, and speaks the truth in his heart.
He has not practiced deceit with his tongue, nor done evil to his neighbor, nor reproached those close to him.
Every wicked person is despised in his sight, but he honors those who fear the Lord. He swears an oath to his neighbor and does not break it.
He has not lent his money at interest or accepted a bribe against the holy ones. Whoever does these things will never be shaken.
An inscription of David. Protect me, Lord, for I have trusted in you.
I said to the Lord, “You are my Lord, for you have no need of my good things.”
He revealed himself to the holy ones in his land; all his desires are fulfilled in them.
Their afflictions multiplied among them; after this they were troubled. I will not gather their assemblies with blood, nor will I mention their names with my lips.
The Lord is the portion of my inheritance and my cup. You are the one who gives me my inheritance.
Measuring lines have fallen to me in excellent places; indeed, my inheritance is secure for me.
I will bless the Lord, who has instructed me. Even at night my kidneys will teach me.
I kept seeing the Lord before me at all times. Because he is at my right hand, I will not be shaken.
Therefore my heart rejoiced, and my tongue was glad. My flesh, too, will rest in hope.
For you will not leave my soul in Hades, nor will you allow your holy one to see decay.
You revealed to me the paths of life. You will fill me with joy in your presence. There is rest at your right hand forever.
The prayer of David. Lord, listen to my righteousness; pay attention to my plea. Listen to my prayer, which does not come from deceitful lips.
Let my judgment come to me from your presence; let my eyes see what is right.
You tested my heart; you visited me at night. You tried me, and you found no wrongdoing in me.
For my mouth will not speak of people's deeds. Because of the words of your lips, I have kept to the difficult paths.
I made my footsteps firm in your paths, so that my footsteps would not slip.
I cried out because you heard me, God. Incline your ear to me and listen to my words.
Let them marvel at your mercies, you who save those who hope in you. Save me by your right hand from those who have risen against me.
Protect me like the pupil of an eye. You will shelter me in the shadow of your wings,
from the wicked who afflicted me. My enemies have seized my soul.
They have enclosed their fat; their mouths have spoken arrogantly.
They are driving me out; now they have surrounded me. They have fixed their eyes on bending down toward the ground.
They stalked me like lions ready for prey, and like young lions staying in hidden places.
Rise, Lord; confront them first and bring them down. Rescue my soul from the hand of the wicked, the sword of the enemies from your hand.
Lord, remove them from the earth; divide them during their lifetime. Let their bellies be filled with your hidden things. They filled their bellies [?] and left the remainder to their children.
But I will appear before your face in righteousness. I will be satisfied when your glory is revealed.
For the end. Of David, the servant of the Lord. The words of this song, which he spoke to the Lord on the day when the Lord rescued him from all his enemies and from Saul. He said:
I will love you, Lord, my strength.
The Lord is my strength, my refuge, and my deliverance. My God is my helper; I will trust in him. He is my shield, the horn of my salvation, and the one who takes me in.
With praise I will call upon the Lord, and I will be saved from my enemies.
The pangs of death seized me, and the destructive waters of lawlessness terrified me.
The pangs of Hades seized me; the snare of death overtook me.
In my distress I called out to the Lord; I cried out to my God. He heard my voice from his holy temple, and my cry before him will enter his ears.
The earth shook and trembled. The foundations of the mountains were disturbed and shook because God was angry with them.
Smoke rose in his anger, and a fire blazed before him; coals were kindled by it.
He bent the sky down and descended, with thick darkness beneath his feet.
He mounted the cherubim and flew; he flew on the wings of the winds.
He made darkness his covering, with his tent surrounding him: water hidden in the clouds of the air.
At the brightness, the clouds passed before him, with hail and coals of fire.
The Lord thundered from heaven, and the Most High gave forth his voice.
He shot arrows and scattered them; he multiplied lightning flashes and threw them into confusion.
The springs of water appeared, and the foundations of the inhabited world were uncovered at your rebuke, Lord, at the blast of your angry breath.
He sent from on high and took me; he took me to himself out of many waters.
He will rescue me from my strong enemies and from those who hate me, because they were stronger than I was.
They confronted me on the day of my distress, but the Lord became my support.
He brought me out into a spacious place. He will rescue me because he delighted in me. He will deliver me from my strong enemies and from those who hate me.
The Lord will reward me according to my righteousness, and he will repay me according to the cleanness of my hands.
For I have kept the ways of the Lord and have not acted wickedly toward my God.
For all his judgments are before me, and I have not put his ordinances away from me.
I will be holy with him, and I will keep myself from my lawlessness.
And the Lord will repay me according to my righteousness and according to the cleanness of my hands before his eyes.
With the holy you will show yourself holy, and with a sinless person you will show yourself sinless.
With the chosen you will show yourself chosen, and with the crooked you will show yourself crooked.
For you will raise up the humble people, and you will bring down the eyes of the proud.
For you are the one who lights my lamp; Lord my God, you light up my darkness.
For through you I will be rescued from a den of robbers, and through my God I will leap over a wall.
My God's way is holy. The words of the Lord have been tested. He is a shield for everyone who hopes in him.
For who is God besides our Lord? Or who is God besides our God?
God is the one who clothes me with strength. You have made my way holy.
He makes my feet like those of deer and sets me firmly on my high places.
He trains my hands for battle. You have made my arms a bronze bow.
You gave me a shield of salvation. Your right hand took hold of me. Your discipline set me upright completely. Your discipline taught me.
You made room for my steps beneath me, and my feet did not weaken.
I will pursue my enemies and overtake them, and I will not turn back until they are destroyed.
I will crush them so that they cannot stand. They will fall beneath my feet.
You clothed me with strength for battle. You brought down beneath me all those who rise up against me.
You put my enemies beneath my feet. You wiped out those who hate me.
They cried out, but there was no one to rescue them. They cried to the Lord, but he did not listen to them.
I will make them crumble like dust before the wind. I will grind them down like mud in the street.
You will rescue me from the disputes of my people, and you will appoint me head of the nations. A people I did not know became my servants.
They obeyed me as soon as they heard me. Foreigners lied to me.
Foreigners grew old and limped away from their paths.
The Lord lives, and blessed is my God! May the God of my salvation be exalted!
God is the one who gives me vengeance, the one who subjected peoples beneath me.
He is my rescuer from my angry enemies. You will lift me above those who rise up against me. You will rescue me from a violent man.
Because of this, I will praise you among the nations, Lord, and I will sing praises to your name.
He gives great deliverance to his king and shows mercy to his anointed one, David, and to his descendants forever.
For the end. A psalm of David.
The heavens declare the glory of God, and the firmament proclaims the work of his hands.
Day speaks a word to day, and night communicates knowledge to night.
There are no languages or words whose voices will not be heard.
Their voice has gone out over the whole earth, and their words have reached the ends of the inhabited world. He has placed his dwelling in the sun.
And it is like a bridegroom coming out of his bridal chamber. It will rejoice like a giant running his course.
Its rising is from one end of heaven, and its setting is at the other end of heaven. No one can hide from its heat.
The law of the Lord is holy, restoring souls. The testimony of the Lord is trustworthy, teaching the little ones.
The ordinances of the Lord are upright, gladdening the heart. The commandment of the Lord is light, enlightening the eyes of the little ones.
The fear of the Lord is holy, enduring forever and ever. The judgments of the Lord are true, all righteous together.
His wishes are preferable to gold and abundant precious stone, and they are sweeter than honey and the honeycomb.
For your servant also keeps them, and in keeping them there is a great reward.
Who can recognize transgressions? Cleanse me, Lord, from hidden faults.
Spare your servant from strangers, so that they do not rule over me. I will be holy, and I will be cleansed from great sin.
The words of my mouth will be blessed, and the meditation of my heart will always be before you, Lord, my helper and my redeemer.
For completion. A psalm of David.
May the Lord hear you on the day of your distress. May the name of the God of Jacob strengthen you.
May he send you help from the sanctuary, and may he take you to himself from Zion.
May he remember all your sacrifices, and may your burnt offerings be rich for him. Pause.
May he grant you what your heart desires and fulfill all your plans.
We will rejoice in your salvation, and we will be exalted in the name of our God. May the Lord fulfill all your requests.
Now I know that the Lord has saved his anointed one. He will hear you from his holy heaven; the salvation of your right hand is mighty.
These rely on chariots, and those on horses, but we will boast in the name of the Lord our God.
They stumbled and fell, but we rose and stood upright.
Lord, save your king, and hear us on the day when we call out to you.
For completion. A psalm of David.
Lord, the king will rejoice in your power, and he will rejoice greatly in your salvation.
You have granted him his heart’s desire, and you have not deprived him of the request of his lips.
For you have given him precedence with the blessings of your goodness. Pause. You have placed a crown of precious stone on his head.
He asked you for life, and you gave it to him: many days, forever and ever.
His glory is great through your salvation. You will place glory and beauty upon him.
For you will give him a blessing forever and ever. You will make him glad with joy in your presence.
For the king trusts in the Lord, and through the mercy of the Most High he will not be shaken.
Your hand will be found among all your enemies; your right hand will find everyone who hates you.
You will make them like a fiery furnace at the time of your appearance, Lord. Lord, you will throw them into confusion in your anger, and fire will consume them.
You will destroy their fruit from the earth and their offspring from among humankind.
For they directed evil against you; they devised plans that they will not be able to carry out.
For you will make them turn their backs; you will aim at their faces with arrows.
Be exalted, Lord, in your strength. We will sing and sing praises to your mighty deeds.
For the end. Concerning help at dawn. A psalm of David.
God, my God, attend to me. Why have you abandoned me? The words of my transgressions are far from my salvation.
My God, I will cry out to you by day, and you will not listen to me; and by night, and it will not be foolishness on my part.
But you dwell among the holy ones, the praise of Israel.
Our ancestors trusted in you; they trusted, and you rescued them.
They cried out to you and were saved. They trusted in you and were not put to shame.
But I am a worm, not a human being, mocked by people and despised by the people.
Everyone who sees me mocks me. They speak with their lips, shake their heads, and say:
“He trusted in the Lord. Let him rescue him; let him save him, if he loves him.”
For you are the one who brought me out of the womb. You are my hope from when I nursed at my mother's breasts [?].
I cast myself upon you from the womb. From when I was inside my mother, you are my God.
Do not stay far from me, for trouble is near me, and there is no one to help.
Many bulls surrounded me; powerful bulls seized me.
They opened their mouths against me like lions that tear prey apart and roar.
I was poured out like water, and all my bones were scattered. My heart became like wax melting within me.
My strength dried up like broken pottery. My tongue stuck to my throat, and you brought me down to the dust of death.
A pack of dogs surrounded me; a gathering of wicked people seized me. They pierced my hands and feet. I will tell of all your wonders.
They counted all my bones, while they watched and stared at me.
They divided my clothes among themselves and cast lots for my clothing.
But you, Lord, do not let your help be far from me. Be attentive and take me to yourself.
Rescue my soul from the sword and my only life from the power of the dogs.
Rescue me from the lion’s mouth, and my lowliness from the horns of the one-horned animals.
I will proclaim your name to my brothers; I will praise you in the midst of the assembly.
You who fear the Lord, praise him! All you descendants of Jacob, give him glory! Let all the descendants of Israel fear him.
For he did not scorn him or despise the poor man’s plea. He did not turn his face away from me, and when I cried out to him, he heard me.
My praise is before you in the great assembly. I will fulfill my vows before everyone who fears him.
The poor will eat and be satisfied, and those who seek the Lord will praise him. Their hearts will live forever and ever.
All the ends of the earth will remember and turn to the Lord, and all the families of the nations will worship before him.
For the kingdom belongs to the Lord, and he rules over all the nations.
All the mighty of the earth ate and worshiped. All who go down to the earth will bow before him. My soul lives for him.
My descendants will serve him. The coming generation will speak of the Lord.
And they will proclaim his righteousness to the people who will be born, whom the Lord has created.
A psalm of David. The Lord is the one who shepherds me, and he will not let me lack anything.
He made me dwell in a grassy place. [?] nourished me beside restful water.
He restored my soul. He led me along the paths of righteousness for the sake of his name.
Even if I walk in the midst of the shadow of death, I will not fear evil, because you are with me. Your rod and your staff are what comforted me.
You prepared a table before me in the presence of those who oppress me. You anointed my head with oil, and your cup is intoxicating, like a powerful drink.
Your mercy will pursue me all the days of my life, because I have dwelt in the house of the Lord for many days.
A psalm of David, for the first day of the week. The earth belongs to the Lord, together with everything in it—the inhabited world and all who dwell in it.
He founded it upon the seas and established it upon the rivers.
Who will go up to the mountain of the Lord? Or who will stand in his holy place?
The one whose hands are holy and whose heart is pure, who has not directed his soul toward vanity and has not sworn deceitfully to his neighbor.
This person will receive a blessing from the Lord and mercy from God his Savior.
This is the generation of those who seek the Lord, those who seek the face of the God of Jacob. Pause.
Lift up your gates, rulers; rise up, everlasting gates, so that the King of glory may enter.
Who is this King of glory? The Lord, strong and mighty, the Lord who is powerful in battle. Musical interlude.
Lift up your gates, rulers; rise up, everlasting gates, so that the King of glory may enter.
Who is this King of glory? The Lord of hosts—he is the King of glory.
For the end. A psalm of David. Lord, I have lifted up my soul to you, my God.
I have trusted in you. Do not let me be put to shame, nor let my enemies laugh at me.
For everyone who waits for you will not be put to shame. Let those who act lawlessly for no reason be put to shame.
Lord, make your ways known to me, and teach me your paths.
Lead me in your truth and teach me, because you are God, my Savior, and I will wait for you all day long.
Remember your compassion, Lord, and your mercies, for they have existed from eternity.
Do not remember the sins of my youth or my acts of ignorance. Remember according to the abundance of your mercy, because of your goodness, Lord.
The Lord is good and upright; therefore he will teach sinners the way.
He will guide the humble in justice; he will teach the humble his ways.
All the Lord’s ways are mercy and truth for those who seek his covenant and his testimonies.
For the sake of your name, Lord, forgive my sin, for it is great.
Who is the person who fears the Lord? He will give him instruction in the way he has chosen.
His soul will dwell among good things, and his descendants will inherit the earth.
The Lord is the strength of those who fear him, and the Lord’s name belongs to those who fear him, to make his covenant known to them.
My eyes are always fixed on the Lord, for he is the one who will pull my feet out of the trap.
Look upon me and have mercy on me, for I am an only child, and I am poor.
The troubles of my heart have increased. Bring me out of my distress.
Look at my humiliation and my suffering, and forgive all my sins.
Look at my enemies, for they have grown numerous, and they have hated me with a violent hatred.
Guard my soul and save me. Do not let me be put to shame, for I have placed my hope in you.
The innocent and the upright have joined themselves to me, because I have waited for you, Lord.
God, deliver [?] from all his troubles.
A psalm of David. Judge me, Lord, for I have walked in my innocence, and because I trust in the Lord, I will not be shaken.
Examine me, Lord, and test me; refine my kidneys and my heart.
For your mercy is before my eyes, and I have pleased you in your truth.
I have not sat with a worthless assembly, and I will not go in with sinners.
I have hated the gathering of evildoers, and I will not sit with the ungodly.
I will wash my hands among the holy ones and go around your altar, Lord,
to hear the sound of your praise and tell of all your wonders.
Lord, I have loved the beauty of your house and the dwelling place of your glory.
Do not destroy my soul along with the ungodly, or my life along with bloodthirsty men,
whose hands hold lawlessness and whose right hand is full of bribes.
But I have walked in my innocence. Redeem me and have mercy on me.
For my foot has stood on level ground. I will praise you, Lord, in the assemblies.
A psalm of David, before he was anointed. The Lord is my light and my savior; whom will I fear? The Lord is the strength of my salvation; before whom will I grow weak?
When those who torment me came near to devour my flesh—those who oppress me and my enemies—they stumbled and fell.
Even if an army encamps against me, my heart will not be afraid. Even if war rises against me, I will remain confident in this.
One thing I have asked of the Lord, and this is what I seek: to dwell in the Lord’s house all the days of my life, to see the Lord’s delight and visit his people.
For he hid me in his tent on the day of trouble. He sheltered me in the hidden place of his tent and lifted me up on a rock.
Now, look! He has raised my head above my enemies. I went around and offered a sacrifice of praise in his tent. I will sing and make music to the Lord.
Lord, hear the voice with which I cried out. Have mercy on me, Lord, and hear me.
My heart spoke to you; it sought your face. Your face, Lord, I will seek.
Do not turn your face away from me. Do not turn away from your servant in anger. Be my helper. Do not reject me or abandon me, God my savior.
For my father and my mother abandoned me, but the Lord took me in.
Lord, instruct me in your way, and lead me along a straight path because of my enemies.
Do not hand me over to the desires of those who oppress me, for false witnesses have risen against me, and the oppressor has lied to himself.
I believe that I will see the good things of the Lord in the land of the living.
I will wait for the Lord. Be strong, and let your heart be firm, and wait for the Lord.
A psalm of David. I cried out to you, Lord my God. Do not remain silent toward me, lest, if you remain silent toward me, I become like those who go down into the pit.
Hear the sound of my pleading when I plead with you and lift my hands toward your holy temple.
Do not drag my soul away with sinners, and do not destroy me with those who practice lawlessness, who speak peacefully with their neighbors while evil is in their hearts.
Give them according to their deeds and according to the wickedness of their thoughts. Repay them according to the works of their hands; give them their recompense.
Because they did not understand the works of the Lord or the works of his hands, you will tear them down and not build them up.
Blessed is the Lord, because he has heard the sound of my pleading.
The Lord is my helper and my strength, in whom my heart trusted. I was afraid; my flesh flourished. I will willingly give thanks to him.
The Lord is the strength of his people and the saving strength of his anointed.
Save your people and bless your inheritance. Shepherd them and lift them up forever.
A psalm of David, from the way of the tent [?]. Bring offerings to the Lord, children of God; bring young rams to the Lord. Bring honor and reverence to the Lord.
Bring glory to his name. Worship the Lord in his holy court.
The voice of the Lord is over the waters. The God of glory cried out; the Lord is over many waters.
The voice of the Lord is powerful; the voice of the Lord is majestic.
The voice of the Lord breaks the cedars; the Lord will break the cedars of Lebanon.
He makes them be crushed, along with Lebanon, like a calf, and the beloved one is like a young unicorn.
The voice of the Lord splits a flame of fire.
The voice of the Lord shakes the wilderness. The Lord will shake the wilderness of Kadesh.
The voice of the Lord prepares the deer, and he will lay bare the forests. Everyone in his temple speaks of his glory.
The Lord brings the flood and makes it settle. The Lord will reign forever.
The Lord will give strength to his people. The Lord will bless his people with peace.
For the end. A psalm, a song for the dedication of the house. Of David.
I will exalt you, Lord, because you have received me and have not let my enemies rejoice over me.
Lord my God, I cried out to you, and you healed me.
Lord, you brought my soul up from the underworld. You saved me from among those who go down into the pit.
Sing praises to the Lord, his holy ones, and give thanks in remembrance of his holiness.
For there is wrath in his anger and life in his favor. Weeping will come in the evening, and rejoicing will come in the morning.
But I said in my prosperity, “I will never be shaken.”
Lord, by your will you gave strength to my beauty. But you turned your face away, and I became troubled.
I will cry out to the Lord and plead with my God.
What profit is there in my blood when I go down to destruction? Will the dust praise you? Will it proclaim your truth?
The Lord heard and had mercy on me. The Lord became my helper.
You turned my mourning into joy for me. You tore off my sackcloth and clothed me with gladness.
So that my right hand may bless you and I may not grieve. Lord my God, I will praise you forever.
For the end. A psalm of David. On astonishment.
I have trusted in you, Lord. Do not let me be put to shame forever. Rescue me and save me in your righteousness.
Turn your ear toward me and hurry to save me. Be a mighty God to me and a house of refuge to save me.
For you are my strength and my refuge. For your name's sake, you will guide me and sustain me.
You will bring me out of this snare that they hid for me, for you are my strength.
I will entrust my spirit to your hands. You have redeemed me, Lord, God of truth.
You have hated those who cling to what is empty, in vain. But I have trusted in the Lord.
I will rejoice and be glad in your mercy, for you have looked upon my humiliation and saved my soul from my troubles.
And you did not hand me over to the enemy. You set my feet in a spacious place.
Have mercy on me, Lord, for I am distressed. My eye is troubled by your anger, as are my soul and my belly.
My life has wasted away in sorrow, and my years in groaning. My strength has weakened through poverty, and my bones are troubled.
I have become an object of reproach to all my enemies, and especially to my neighbors, and an object of fear to those who know me. Those who saw me kept away from me.
For they have forgotten me in their hearts like the dead. I have become like a lost vessel.
For I heard the slander of many who live around me. When they gathered together against me, they plotted to take my life.
But I have trusted in you, Lord. I said, "You are my God."
My allotted times are in your hands. Save me from the hand of my enemies and those who pursue me.
Let your face shine upon your servant. Save me by your mercy.
Lord, do not let me be put to shame, for I cried out to you. Let the ungodly be put to shame and be taken to Hades.
Let deceitful lips become silent—those that speak wickedly against the righteous with arrogance and contempt.
How abundant is your goodness, Lord, which you have stored up for those who fear you! You have allotted it to those who hope in you, in the sight of humankind.
You will hide them in the shelter of your presence from the turmoil of people. You will shelter them in a refuge from the disputes of tongues.
Blessed is the Lord, for he has made his mercy glorious toward me in a fortified city.
But I said in my distress, “Perhaps I have been cast out of your sight.” Yet you heard the sound of my plea when I cried out to you.
Love the Lord, all his holy ones, for the Lord seeks truth and will repay those who are exceedingly proud.
Be strong, and let your hearts gain strength, all you who hope in my Lord.
For instruction. By David. Blessed are those whose lawless deeds have been forgiven and whose sins have been covered.
Blessed is the person whose sin the Lord will not count against him, and in whose mouth there is no deceit.
I kept silent, for my bones grew old as I cried out all day long.
For day and night your hand weighed heavily on me. I was brought into misery when I was pierced as with thorns. Musical interlude.

I confessed my sin; I did not hide my lawlessness. I said, “I will confess to the Lord my sin that stands against me.” And you are the one who will forgive the wickedness of my heart. Musical interlude.
Every holy person will pray to you about this at the appointed time. But even in a flood of many waters, they will not come near him.
You are my refuge from the trouble that surrounds me. My joy, rescue me from those around me. Musical interlude.
I will instruct you and teach you the way you should go. I will keep my eyes fixed on you.
Do not be like horses and mules, which have no understanding. Pull the jaws of those who do not come near you with a bit and a bridle.
Many are the scourges of the sinner, but mercy will surround those who hope in the Lord.
You righteous people, rejoice in the Lord and be glad. Boast in him, all you who are upright in heart.
By David. You righteous people, rejoice in the Lord. Praise is fitting for the upright.
Give thanks to the Lord with a lyre; play music to him on a ten-stringed harp.
Sing him a new song; play skillfully to him with a shout of joy.
For the Lord’s word is upright, and all his works are done in faithfulness.
He loves mercy and justice. The whole earth is full of the Lord’s mercy.
And by his word the heavens were made firm, and all their forces by the breath of his mouth.
He gathers the waters of the sea as in wineskins; he placed the depths in their storehouses.
Let the whole earth fear the Lord. Let every place tremble before him, along with everyone who lives in them.
For he spoke, and they came into being; he commanded, and they were created.
The Lord will scatter the counsel of the nations. He will thwart the thoughts of the peoples, and he will thwart the plans of rulers.
But the Lord’s counsel remains forever, the thoughts of his heart from generation to generation.
Blessed is the nation whose God is the Lord, the people whom the Lord has chosen as his inheritance.
The Lord looked down from heaven and saw all the children of humanity.
From his prepared dwelling place, he looked upon everyone who lives on the earth.
He alone formed their hearts; he understands all their deeds.
No king will be saved by his great power, and no mighty warrior will be rescued by his abundant strength.
No horse [?] can bring salvation; it cannot rescue by its great strength.
Look, the Lord's eyes watch over those who fear him, those who put their trust in his mercy,
to save their souls from death and sustain them during famine.
Our soul will wait patiently for the Lord, because he is our helper and our strength.
For our heart will rejoice in him, and we have trusted in his holy name.
May your mercy, Lord, be upon us, just as we have placed our hope in you.
A psalm of David, when he changed his appearance before Ahimelech, who sent him away, and he departed.
I will bless the Lord at all times; his praise is always in my mouth.
My soul will take pride in the Lord. Let the humble hear and rejoice.
Be exalted with me in the Lord, and exalt his name together.
I sought the Lord, and he heard me and saved me from all my entanglements.
Come toward him and become radiant, and your faces will not be put to shame.
This is the poor man who cried out; the Lord heard him and saved him from all his troubles.
The angel of the Lord surrounds those who fear him and rescues them.
Taste and know that the Lord is sweet. Blessed is the person who places his hope in him.
Fear the Lord, you his holy ones, because those who fear him lack nothing.
The rich became poor and went hungry, but those who seek the Lord will lack no good thing. Musical interlude.
Come, my children, and listen to me; I will teach you the fear of the Lord.
Who is the person who desires life and loves to see good days?
Keep your tongue from evil and your lips from speaking deceit.
Turn away from evil and do good. Seek peace and pursue it.
For the Lord’s eyes watch over the righteous, and his ears incline toward their plea.
But the Lord’s face is against those who do evil, to erase their memory from the earth.
The righteous cried out, and the Lord heard them and saved them from all their troubles.
The Lord is near to the brokenhearted, and he will save those who are humble in spirit.
The troubles of the righteous are many, but the Lord will rescue them from them all.
The Lord will protect all their bones; not one of them will be broken.
The death of sinners is terrible, and those who hate the righteous will be guilty.
The Lord will redeem the souls of his servants, and no one who puts their hope in him will be guilty.
Of David. Lord, judge those who treat me unjustly; fight against those who fight against me.
Take hold of a weapon and a shield, and rise to help me.
Draw a sword and block the way before those who oppress me. Say to my soul, “I am your Savior.”
Let everyone who seeks my life be ashamed and disgraced. Let those who plan evil against me turn back in shame.
Let them become like chaff before the wind, with the Lord’s angel driving them on.
Let their path become dark and slippery for them, with the Lord’s angel pursuing them.
For they hid a trap for me without cause, to their own destruction; they harassed my soul without cause.
Let a trap come upon them without their knowing it, and let the snare they hid catch them. They will fall into the trap.
But my soul will rejoice in the Lord and be glad in his salvation.
All my bones will say, “Lord, who is like you? You rescue the poor from the hand of those stronger than they are, the poor and needy from those who rob them.”
Unjust witnesses rose against me; they questioned me about things I did not know.
They repaid me with evil instead of good, leaving my soul bereft of children.
But when they troubled me, I put on sackcloth. I humbled my soul with fasting, and my prayer will return inward.
I conducted myself as for a neighbor and a brother; I was humbled like someone mourning and grieving.
They gathered against me and rejoiced. Scourges gathered against me, and I did not understand. They scattered and felt no remorse.
They put me to the test and mocked me with mockery; they gnashed their teeth at me.
Lord, how long will you look on? Rescue my life from their evil plotting, my only life from the lions.
I will give thanks to you, Lord, in a great assembly; I will praise you among a large gathering of people.
Do not let those who are unjustly hostile to me rejoice over me, or those who hate me without cause wink their eyes.
For they spoke words of peace to me, but in their anger they were planning deceit.
They opened their mouths wide against me and said, “Aha! Aha! We have seen it with our own eyes!”
You have seen it, Lord; do not be silent. Lord, do not be far from me.
Rise, Lord, and attend to my judgment, my God and my Lord, to my defense.
Judge me according to your righteousness, Lord my God, and do not let them rejoice over me.
Do not let them say in their hearts, “Good! Just what we wanted!” And do not let them say, “We have swallowed him up.”
Let those who rejoice over my troubles be ashamed and humiliated together. Let those who speak boastfully against me be clothed in shame and humiliation.
Let those who desire my vindication rejoice and be glad. Let those who desire peace for his servant always say, “May the Lord be exalted!”
And my tongue will rejoice in your righteousness and your praise all day long.
For the director. By David, the servant of the Lord.
The lawless person says in his heart, “I will sin.” The fear of God is not before his eyes.
For he acted deceitfully in his sight, to find his lawlessness and hate it.
The words of his mouth are lawlessness and deceit. He did not want to know what is good and do it.
He thought about lawlessness on his bed. He stood on every evil path, and he did not hate wickedness.
Lord, your mercy is in heaven, and your faithfulness reaches to the clouds.
Your righteousness is like the mountains of God; your judgments are like the great deep. You will save people and animals, Lord.
How greatly you have increased your mercy, God! The children of humanity will put their hope in the shadow of your wings.
They will be satisfied by the abundance of your house, and you will give them drink from the river of your delight.
For the fountain of life is with you; in your light we will see light.
Extend your mercy to those who know you, and your righteousness to those whose hearts are upright.
Do not let the foot of the proud come against me, and do not let the hand of sinners move me.
For there those who practice lawlessness have fallen. They have been destroyed and will not be able to stand.
Of David. Do not be envious of those who are wicked, nor be envious of those who practice lawlessness.
For they will quickly dry up like grass, and they will quickly wither like green plants.
Put your hope in the Lord and do good. Live in the land, and you will be nourished by its riches.
Take delight in the Lord, and he will grant you the requests of your heart.
Reveal your way to the Lord and put your hope in him, and he will act for you.
He will bring out your righteousness like the light, and your judgments like noonday.
Submit to the Lord and plead with him. Do not envy someone who prospers in life, a person who commits lawless deeds.
Turn away from anger and leave rage behind. Do not become so jealous that you do evil.
For evildoers will be destroyed, but those who wait for the Lord will inherit the land.
In just a little while, the sinner will be no more. You will look for his place but will not find him.
The meek will inherit the land, and they will be sustained by abundant peace.
The sinner plots against the righteous person and grinds his teeth at him.
But the Lord will laugh at him, because he sees that his day is coming.
The sinners have drawn their sword and bent their bow to bring down the poor and needy and to slaughter those who are upright in heart.
Their sword will enter their own heart, and their arrows will be broken.
The little that a righteous person has is better than the abundant wealth of sinners.
For the arms of sinners will be broken, but the Lord strengthens the righteous.
The Lord knows the ways of his holy ones, and their inheritance will last forever.
They will not be put to shame in an evil time, and they will have enough to eat in the days of famine.
For sinners will perish. When the Lord’s enemies gain glory and are exalted, they vanish; they have vanished like smoke.
The sinner borrows and does not repay, but the righteous person has compassion and gives.
For those who bless him will inherit the land, but those who curse him will be destroyed.
A person’s ways are made straight by the Lord, and he will delight in his way.
If the righteous person falls, he will not be shaken, because the Lord supports him.
I was young, and now I have grown old. I have not seen a righteous person abandoned, or his descendants searching for bread.
All day long he shows mercy and gives, and his descendants will be blessed.
Turn away from evil and do good, and you will dwell forever and ever.
For the Lord loves justice and will not abandon his holy ones. They will be protected forever. The holy ones will be judged, and the descendants of the ungodly will be destroyed.
The righteous will inherit the land and live on it forever and ever.
The mouth of the righteous person will meditate on wisdom, and his tongue will speak of justice.
The law of his God is in his heart, and his steps will not slip.
The sinner watches the righteous person and seeks to kill him.
But the Lord will not hand him over into his hands or condemn him when he is brought to judgment.
Wait patiently for the Lord and keep his way, and he will raise you up to inherit the land. You will see the sinners being wiped out.
I saw the ungodly man exalting himself and rising up like the cedars of Lebanon.
I passed by him, and he had disappeared. I searched for his place but did not find him.
Keep your innocence and observe what is upright, for there is a future for the person who makes peace.
But the lawless will be wiped out together; the posterity of the ungodly will be destroyed.
The salvation of the righteous comes from the Lord, and he is their strength in their time of distress.
The Lord will help them and rescue them. He will save them from sinners and rescue them because they have placed their hope in him.
A psalm of David, for remembrance, concerning the Sabbath.
Lord, do not rebuke me in your anger or discipline me in your wrath.
For your arrows have shaken me, and you have pressed your hand down upon me.
There is no healing in my flesh because of your anger; there is no peace in my bones because of my sins.
For my sins have risen above my head; they have weighed down upon me like a heavy burden.
My wounds have become foul and festered because of my foolishness.
I have suffered and have been bent down completely. I went about mourning all day long.
For my soul is filled with ridicule, and there is no healing in my flesh.
I have suffered and have been greatly humbled. I cried out because of the groaning of my heart.
All my longing is before you, Lord, and the groaning of my heart is not hidden from you.
My heart is troubled; my strength has left me, and even the light of my eyes is no longer with me.
My friends and my companions approached me and stood there, while those close to me stood far away.
Those seeking my life used violence, and those seeking to harm me spoke empty words. They plotted deceit all day long.
But I was [?] because of them, and I became like a deaf person who does not hear and like a mute person who does not open his mouth.
I became like a person who does not hear and has no rebuke in his mouth.
I have trusted in you. You are the one who will listen to me, Lord my God.
For I said, “Do not let my enemies rejoice over me.” When my feet slipped, they spoke boastfully against me.
For I am ready for blows, and my suffering is always before you.
For I will declare my lawlessness, and I will be concerned about my sin.
My enemies are alive and are stronger than I am. Those who hate me unjustly have multiplied.
Those who repay me with evil instead of good opposed me because I pursued righteousness. They cast me, the beloved, out like a repulsive murderer.
Do not abandon me, Lord my God; do not withdraw from me.
Pay attention and help me, Lord, God of my salvation.
For the end. For Jeduthun. A song of David.
I said, “I will guard my ways so that I do not sin with my tongue.” I placed a guard at my mouth while the sinner stood before me.
I became mute; I was troubled and humbled. I kept silent about my blessings, and my pain was renewed.
My heart grew hot within me, and a fire was burning as I meditated. I spoke with my tongue:
“Lord, let me know my end and the number of my days, how many they are, so that I may know what I lack.
Look, you have made my days grow old, and my strength is like nothing before you. Surely every living person is altogether empty. Musical interlude.
Indeed, a person walks about like an image, yet troubles himself for nothing. He gathers things together without knowing for whom he gathers them.
Now, who is my hope? Is it not the Lord? And is not my support with you?
Save me from all my lawless deeds. You have made me an object of ridicule to fools.
I became mute and did not open my mouth, because you are the one who made me.
Take your scourges away from me, for I have grown weak under the power of your hand.
You disciplined a person with rebukes for his lawlessness; you made his soul waste away like a spider. Surely every living person is troubled. Musical interlude.
Hear my prayer and my plea; listen to my tears. Do not remain silent toward me, for I am a foreigner on the earth and a temporary resident, like all my ancestors.
Give me relief so that I may rest before I go away and no longer exist.”
For the end. A psalm of David.
I waited patiently for the Lord. He paid attention to me and heard my plea.
He brought me up from the pit of misery and from the muddy mire. He set my feet on a rock and made my steps firm.
He put a new song in my mouth, a song of praise to our God. Many will see, fear, and put their hope in the Lord.
Blessed is the person whose hope is the name of the Lord, who has not looked to empty things or deceptive madness.
You, Lord God, have multiplied your wonders, and no one is like you in your thoughts. I spoke of them and proclaimed them; they have become too many to count.
You did not desire sacrifice and offering, but you prepared a body for me. You did not desire burnt offerings or offerings made for sin.
Then I said, “Look, I am coming. It is written about me in the scroll of a book,
to do your will, my God; and your law is within my heart.”
I proclaimed the good news of righteousness in a great assembly. Look, I will not restrain my lips. Lord, you know this.
As for my righteousness, I did not hide your truth in my heart, and I spoke of your salvation. I did not hide your mercy and your truth from a large congregation.
But you, Lord, do not let your compassion be far from me. Your mercy and your truth have always taken me into their care.
For countless evils have seized me. My lawless deeds have overtaken me, and I could not see. They have become more numerous than the hairs of my head, and my heart has abandoned me.
Lord, be willing to save me. Lord, give your attention to helping me.
May those who seek my life to destroy it be ashamed and humiliated together. May those who wish me harm turn back and be humiliated.
Let those who say to me, “Well done! Well done!” be put to shame immediately.
Let everyone who seeks you rejoice and be glad in you, Lord. Let those who always love your salvation say at all times, “May the Lord be exalted!”
But I am poor and needy. The Lord cares for me. You are my helper and my support. My God, do not delay.
For the completion. The psalm of David.
Blessed is the person who gives attention to the poor and needy. The Lord will save him on a day of trouble.
He will protect him and keep him alive and bless him on the earth. He will not hand him over to his enemy.
The Lord will help him on his bed of suffering. You have turned over his entire bed during his illness.
I said, “Lord, have mercy on me. Heal my soul, for I have sinned against you.”
My enemies spoke evil against me: “When will he die and his name perish?”
And he would come in to see me, speaking empty words. His heart gathered lawlessness for himself. He would go out and speak against me.
All my enemies were whispering together against me. They were plotting evil against me.
They have devised a lawless statement against me: “Will the one who lies down not rise again?”
For even the man who was at peace with me, whom I trusted,
the one who eats bread with me, has raised his heel against me. But you, Lord, have mercy on me and raise me up, so that I may repay them.
By this I knew that you loved me: my enemy will not rejoice over me.
But you have taken me into your care because of my innocence, and you have established me before you forever.
Blessed is the Lord, the God of Israel, from eternity to eternity. So be it! So be it!
For the completion. The wisdom of the sons of Korah.
As a deer longs to stay beside streams of water, so my soul longs to come to you, God.
My soul thirsts for the living God. When will I come and appear before my God?
My tears have become my bread by day and by night, while they say to me every day, “Where is your God?”

I remembered these things and poured out my soul within me, for I am going through a wondrous tabernacle to the house of God, with a voice of rejoicing and thanksgiving, the sound of someone celebrating a feast.
Why are you sorrowful, my soul, and why do you trouble me? Hope in God, for I will praise him. My God is the salvation of my face.
My soul was troubled within me. Therefore I will remember you, Lord, from the land of the Jordan and Hermon, from the small mountain.
Deep will call to deep at the sound of your waterfalls. All your surges and your waves have come down upon me.
The Lord will command his mercy by day and make it known at night. My prayer is with me, directed to the God of my life.
I will say to my God, “You are the one who receives me. Why have you forgotten me? Why have you abandoned me? And why do I walk in sorrow while my enemy oppresses me?”
As my bones were crushed, those who oppress me mocked me, saying to me every day, “Where is your God?”
Why, my soul, are you sorrowful, and why do you trouble me? Hope in God, for I will praise him. My God is the salvation of my face.
A psalm of David. Judge me, God, and plead my case against an impure nation. Save me from an unjust and deceitful person.
For you are God, my strength. Why have you abandoned me? And why do I walk in sorrow while my enemy oppresses me? As my bones were crushed, my enemies mocked me.
Send out your light and your truth. They are the ones that guided me and brought me to your holy mountain and to your dwelling places.
I will approach the altar of God, before God who brings joy to my youth. I will praise you, my God, with a lyre.
Why are you sorrowful, my soul, and why do you trouble me? Hope in God, for I will praise him. My God is the salvation of my face.
For the end. A psalm of wisdom by the sons of Korah.
God, we have heard with our ears. Our fathers told us about the work you did in their days, in the days of old.
Your hand uprooted nations, and you planted them. You afflicted peoples and cast them out.
For they did not inherit the land by their sword, nor was it their arm that saved them, but your right hand, your arm, and the light of your face, because you loved them.
You are my king and my God, the one who commands deliverance for Jacob.
Through you we will strike down our enemies, and in your name we will trample those who rise against us.
For I do not trust in my bow, and it is not my sword that will save me.
For you saved us from those who oppress us, and you put those who hate us to shame.
In our God we will take pride all day long, and we will praise your name forever. Pause.
But now you have rejected us and put us to shame, and you do not go out with our armies.
You made us turn back before our enemies. Those who hate us plundered us for themselves.
You handed us over like sheep to be eaten, and you scattered us among the nations.
You gave away your people without a price, and there was no gain from selling us.
You have made us an object of reproach to our neighbors, of mockery and ridicule to those around us.
You have made us a byword among the nations, a reason for the peoples to shake their heads.
For my disgrace is before me all day long, and shame has covered my face,
because of the voice of the one who reproaches and slanders, in the presence of the enemy and the persecutor.
All these things have come upon us, but we have not forgotten you, nor have we acted unjustly toward your covenant.
And our heart has not turned back; you have turned our paths away from your way.
For you have humbled us in a place of suffering, and the shadow of death has covered us.
If we have forgotten the name of our God, if we have stretched out our hands to a foreign god,
will not God investigate these things? For he knows the secrets of the heart.
For because of you we are being killed all day long; we have been counted as sheep for slaughter.
Wake up, Lord! Why are you sleeping? Rise up; do not abandon us forever.
Why have you turned your face away and forgotten our poverty and our affliction?
For our soul has been brought low to the earth, and our heart has clung to the ground.
Rise up and help us, Lord, and redeem us for the sake of your name.
For the end. Concerning those who will change. Of the sons of Korah. For understanding. A song concerning the beloved.
My heart has poured out a good word. I will speak of my works to the king. My tongue is the pen of a scribe who writes quickly.
He is more beautiful in appearance than other men. Grace has poured out upon your lips; therefore God has blessed you forever.
Strap your sword to your thigh, mighty one, in your beauty and your splendor.
Prepare yourself, advance, and reign for the sake of truth, gentleness, and righteousness. Your right hand will guide you wonderfully.
Your arrows are sharp, mighty one, in the hearts of the king’s enemies. Peoples will fall beneath you.
Your throne, O God, lasts forever and ever. The scepter of your kingdom is a scepter of uprightness.
You have loved righteousness and hated injustice. Therefore God, your God, has anointed you with the oil of gladness beyond your companions.
Myrrh, fragrant resin, and cassia come from your garments, from the splendid ivory palaces where they have made you glad,
the daughters of kings, honoring you. The queen stood at your right hand in a garment adorned with gold, clothed in many colors.
Listen, my daughter, and look and incline your ear. Forget your people and your father’s house.
For the king has desired their word; he is their lord.
The daughters of Tyre will bow down to him with gifts; the rich people of the earth will seek your favor.
All the glory of the king’s daughter is within; she is clothed in golden garments of many colors.
Virgins will be brought to the king behind her; those who are close to her will be brought to you.
They will be brought with joy; they will be brought with gladness into the king’s temple.
In place of your fathers, sons have been born to you, and you will appoint them as rulers over all the earth.
They will remember your name in every generation, one generation after another. Therefore the peoples will praise you forever and forever and ever.
For the end. For the sons of Korah. Concerning hidden things. A psalm of David.
Our God is our refuge and our strength, our helper in the troubles that have overwhelmed us.
Therefore we will not be afraid when the earth is shaken and the mountains are moved away.
Their waters roared in the depths of the seas and were stirred up; the mountains shook at his power. Pause.
The river’s channels will gladden the city of God; the Most High has made his dwelling holy.
God is in her midst, and she will not be shaken. God will help her at dawn.
The nations were shaken; the kingdoms tottered. He raised his voice, and the earth shook.
The Lord of hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is the one who takes us into his protection. Pause.
Come and see the works of God, the wonders he has done on the earth.
He puts an end to wars to the ends of the earth. He will break the bow and shatter the weapon, and he will burn the shields with fire.
Be still and see that I am God. I will be exalted among the nations; I will be exalted on the earth.
The Lord God of hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is the one who takes us into his protection.
For the end. For the sons of Korah. A psalm.
All you nations, clap your hands! Shout to God with a joyful voice!
For the Lord is exalted and awe-inspiring; he is a great king over all the earth.
He subdued peoples for us and nations under our feet.
He chose his inheritance for us, the beauty of Jacob, whom he loved. Pause.
God went up with a shout, the Lord with the sound of a trumpet.
Sing praises to our God, sing praises! Sing praises to our king, sing praises!
For our God is the King of the whole earth. Sing praises with understanding.
The Lord has become King over all the nations. God sits on his holy throne.
The rulers of the peoples have gathered together with the God of Abraham, for God's mighty ones of the earth have been greatly exalted.
A song. A psalm of the sons of Korah, for the second day of the week.
The Lord is great and greatly blessed in the city of our God, on his holy mountain.
It stretches out in joy over the whole earth: the mountains of Zion, the heights of the north, the city of the great King.
God will reveal himself in her splendid dwellings when he helps her.
For look, her kings gathered together; they came to one place.
When they saw this, they were amazed; they were troubled and shaken.
Trembling seized them there, like the labor pains of a woman giving birth.
With a violent wind he will shatter the ships of Tarshish.
Just as we heard, so we have also seen in the city of the Lord of hosts, in the city of our God. God has established its foundation forever. Pause.
We were thinking of you, God, because of your mercy in the midst of your people.
As your name is, O God, so is your praise to the ends of the earth. Your right hand is full of righteousness.
Let Mount Zion be glad, and let the daughters of Judea rejoice because of your judgments, Lord.
Go around Zion and encircle her.
Tell of her towers. Set your hearts on her strength, and divide up her splendid dwellings, so that you may tell another generation
that this is God, our God forever and ever. He is the one who will shepherd us forever.
For the end. A psalm of the sons of Korah.
Hear these things, all you nations. Listen, all who live in the inhabited world,
those born of the earth and the children of humankind, the rich together with the poor.
My mouth will speak wisdom, and the meditation of my heart will be understanding.
I will incline my ear to a parable; I will explain my riddle with a harp.
Why should I be afraid on an evil day? The lawlessness of my heel will surround me.
Those who trust in their power and boast about the abundance of their wealth
cannot ransom a brother. No man can ransom him or give God his ransom
and the price of redeeming his soul.
He has toiled forever; he will live on to the end, for he will not see destruction when he sees the wise dying.
The fool and the ignorant will perish together; they will leave their wealth to others.
Their tombs are their homes forever, their dwelling places from generation to generation. They have named their lands after themselves.
A person who is honored but has not understood it has been thrown in with the animals that lack understanding; he understood them.
This is their way, which is a stumbling block to them. After these things, they will bless with their mouths. Pause.

He has placed them like sheep in the realm of the dead; death is their shepherd. The upright will rule over them in the morning. Their help will linger in the realm of the dead; they have been stripped of their glory.
But God will redeem my soul from the power of the realm of the dead when he receives me. Pause.
Do not be afraid when a person becomes rich, or when his glory and that of his household increase.
For when he dies, he will not take all these things with him, nor will his glory or that of his household go down with him.
For his soul will receive blessing during his life. He will acknowledge you when you do good to him.
He will join the generation of his ancestors, and he will never see the light.
A person who is honored but has not understood it has been compared to the animals that lack understanding; he has become like them.
The psalm of Asaph. God, the God of gods, the Lord, has spoken and summoned the earth from where the sun rises to where it sets.
The splendor of his beauty is in Zion. God is coming openly, and our God will not remain silent.
A fire will blaze before him, and a great storm is around him.
He will call to heaven above and to the earth from on high, to judge his people.
Gather his holy ones to him, those who establish his covenant through sacrifices.
The heavens will proclaim his righteousness, and in the last days God will search Jerusalem with a lamp, for God is a judge. Pause.
Listen, my people, and I will speak to you. Israel, I will testify to you. I am God, your God.
I will not rebuke you for your sacrifices; your burnt offerings are always before me.
I will not take a calf from your house or goats from your folds.
For all the wild animals of the forest are mine, the animals on the mountains and the cattle.
I know all the birds of the sky, and the beauty of the field is with me.
If I become hungry, I will not tell you, for the inhabited world and everything in it are mine.
Will I eat the flesh of calves or drink the blood of goats?
Offer God a sacrifice of praise, and fulfill your vows to the Most High.
Call on me in the day of your distress, and I will rescue you, and you will glorify me. Pause.
God said to the sinner, “Why do you speak of my decrees and take my covenant on your lips?
But you hated instruction and threw my words behind you.
Whenever you saw a thief, you ran with him, and you took your place among adulterers.
Your mouth spread evil, and your tongue wove deceit.
You sat speaking against your brother, and you placed a stumbling block in the way of your mother’s son.
You did these things, and I kept silent. You thought lawlessly that I would be like you. I will rebuke you and set these things before you.
Understand these things, then, you who forget God, lest he tear you apart and there be no one to rescue you.
A sacrifice of praise will honor me, and there is the holy way that I will show you—the salvation of God.”
For the end. A psalm of David.
When Nathan the prophet came to him, after he had gone in to Bathsheba.
Have mercy on me, God, according to your great mercy. According to the abundance of your compassion, wipe away my sin.
Wash me thoroughly from my lawlessness, and cleanse me from my sin.
For I know my lawlessness, and my sin is before me at all times.
I have sinned against you alone and done evil in your sight, so that you may be justified in your words and prevail when you judge me.
For look, I was conceived in lawlessness, and my mother conceived me in sins.
For look, you loved truth. You revealed to me the hidden and unrevealed things of your wisdom.
You will sprinkle me with hyssop from the blood of the tree, and I will be clean. You will wash me in it, and I will be whiter than snow.
You will make me hear joy and gladness. The bones that have been humbled will rejoice.
Turn your face away from my sins, and wipe away all my lawlessness.
Create a holy heart in me, God, and let an upright spirit be renewed within me.
Do not cast me away from your presence, and do not take your Holy Spirit away from me.
Give me the joy of your salvation, and strengthen me with a guiding spirit.
I will teach the lawless your ways, and the ungodly will return to you.
Save me from bloodshed, God, the God of my salvation, and my tongue will rejoice in your righteousness.
Lord, you will open my lips, and my mouth will proclaim your praise.
For if you wanted a sacrifice, I would give it. You do not want a burnt offering.
The sacrifice to God is a broken spirit. God will not reject a broken and humbled heart.
Lord, do good to Zion according to your will, and let the walls of Jerusalem be built.
Then you will desire righteous sacrifices, burnt offerings and whole burnt offerings. Then they will offer calves on your altar.
For the end. An instruction by David.
When Doeg the Edomite came and told Saul, “David has come to the house of Ahimelech.”
Why does the powerful man boast of evil all day long?
Your tongue plotted injustice. Like a sharpened razor, you practiced deceit.
You loved evil more than good, injustice more than words of righteousness.
You loved all words that devour, with a deceitful tongue.
For this reason God has torn you down completely. He will pull you up and remove you from your dwelling, and uproot you from the land of the living. Pause.
The righteous will see and be afraid. They will laugh at him and say,
"Look at the man who did not make God his helper, but trusted in the abundance of his wealth and drew strength from his own worthlessness."
But I am like a flourishing olive tree in the house of God. I have trusted in God's mercy forever and ever.
I will give thanks to you forever because you have acted for me, and I will wait for your mercy, for it is good in the presence of your holy ones.
For the end. Concerning Mahalath. An instruction by David.
The fool said in his heart, "There is no God." They became corrupt and detestable in their lawless deeds. There is no one who does good, not even one.
God looked down from heaven upon humanity to see whether anyone had understanding and sought God.
They all turned away; together they became useless. There is no one who does good, not even one.
Will not all those who do evil understand—those who devour my people like a meal of bread? They have not called on God.
There they will be terrified where there is nothing to fear, because God has scattered the bones of those who seek to please people. They were put to shame because God despised them.
Who will bring Israel's salvation out of Zion? When the Lord brings back his captive people, Jacob will rejoice and Israel will be glad.
For the end. A psalm by David.
When the Ziphites came and said to Saul, "Look, David is hiding among us."
Save me, my God, by your name, and judge me by your power.
My God, hear my prayer; listen to the words of my mouth.
For strangers have risen against me, and violent men have sought my life. They have not kept God before them. Pause.
For look, God will help me, and the Lord is the one who sustains my life.
He will repay my enemies with evil. Wipe them out in your truth.
